title.value: Improving day-ahead Solar Irradiance Time Series Forecasting by Leveraging Spatio-Temporal Context
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Improving day-ahead Solar Irradiance Time Series Forecasting by Leveraging Spatio-Temporal Context

extractions.description: This paper presents a deep learning architecture that uses satellite data to improve the accuracy of day-ahead time-series forecasting for solar irradiance, with a focus on Global Horizontal Irradiance (GHI). It also introduces a new multi-modal dataset combining satellite imagery with solar irradiance and other physical variables.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving solar irradiance forecasting, which is directly related to the integration of solar power into the electrical grid, a key component of climate change mitigation.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Solar power harbors immense potential in mitigating climate change by substantially reducing CO2 emissions.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on improving solar irradiance forecasting to better integrate solar power into the grid.
primary_category.quote: Solar power has become an increasingly important source of renewable energy in recent years, with the potential to help mitigate the effects of climate change by reducing greenhouse gas emissions.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper aims to improve the forecasting of solar irradiance to facilitate a more efficient and reliable integration of solar power into the grid.
primary_sub_category.quote: Accurate forecasting of solar irradiance can assist grid operators in dealing with the variability of solar power, leading to a more efficient and dependable integration of solar power into the grid.
